name: A1 operation registry
definition: A1 operation registry centralizes operation dispatch. The three thin adapters (CLI, MCP, REST) share the same dispatch path; source-scan drift checks now compare against inventory::iter. Phase 3 deleted the old middleman and the codebase's operations are authored once.

revisions.definition: A1 operation registry: #[op] proc-macro expands OpsRuntime methods into inventory entries dispatched by CLI, MCP, and REST adapters.

A1 operation registry: the #[op] proc-macro in rein-macros expands OpsRuntime methods into inventory-registered entries. CLI/MCP/REST adapters share dispatch. AuthPolicy middleware and OpsErrorKind-to-HTTP mapping were added.

name: HDBSCAN clustering
definition: HDBSCAN semantic clustering in rein extracts flat clusters from a stability-scored condensed tree. The pipeline samples when n>3000 to bound cost. Output feeds M2 per-cluster alpha optimization, M3 decay, and A1 per-cluster dedup thresholds. Lives in store/hdbscan.rs.

revisions.definition: HDBSCAN clustering groups memories by semantic similarity for downstream adaptive learning.
HDBSCAN clustering in rein builds a dendrogram from mutual reachability distances and extracts flat clusters via EOMBST. Output feeds M2 alpha optimization and M3 Kaplan-Meier survival decay.
